title: fork-preflight release data
description: What one PX4 release defines, as generated by generator/generate.py into data/releases/<release>.json.

format.description: Layout of this file. Changes when a field is added, renamed or removed.

release.description: A release tag, or main at the pinned commit.

license.description: The license of the source the data is derived from.

tools.description: Versions of the Python packages that ran the source tree's own tools, and of git, which produced the removal history.

symbols.description: Symbols defined when the root Kconfig is loaded without a board (VENDOR, MODEL and LABEL empty). Sorted.

board_symbols.description: Extra symbols that a board's own Kconfig adds, keyed vendor/model. Only boards that add symbols are listed.

generated.description: Kconfig files the build generates before it loads Kconfig, which the generator produced with the tree's own tools.

removed.description: Global symbols the previous data release defines and this one does not, with what PX4's git history between the two pinned commits shows. Null for the first data release.

commands.description: Shell command names (MAIN of px4_add_module) and the CMakeLists.txt files that declare them.

parameters.description: Parameter names from the param-lineage snapshot of the release, or null when param-lineage has none (see notes).

removed.description: Parameters the release removed relative to the previous release param-lineage tracks, with its curated kind and successors where it has them.

notes.description: Plain statements about gaps in this file.

removed_by.description: Up to 3 non-merge commits between the two releases that delete the symbol's config line (or a Zenoh topic's msg file), in git rev-list order.

evidence.description: Which rule found the successors: renamed (the removing commit adds it with a matching name, or a Zenoh msg file was renamed), boards (in-tree boards set it instead), selected (the symbol selected it), or null.

successors.description: Symbols this release defines that took over, sorted; empty when the history shows none.

via.description: Renamed only: intermediate names added and removed again between the two releases, in order.

boards.description: Boards evidence only, per successor: how many board files set it where the removed symbol was set, out of how many, counted per commit (same-commit) or between the two releases (net).
